categories.main_business_segments: Lai Yih Footwear Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the OEM manufacturing of footwear products, focusing on sports shoes, casual shoes, and specialized footwear such as vulcanized and cold-bonded shoes. The company serves major international sports and outdoor brands, providing high-quality production and development services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced manufacturing technologies including automated and semi-automated production lines, patented key process equipment, and modular flexible manufacturing systems. It invests in R&D for eco-friendly materials, 3D visual recognition quality inspection systems, automated spraying and cutting technologies, and supercritical foam EVA midsole innovations, aiming to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lai Yih's primary customers are internationally renowned sports and outdoor footwear brands, including major groups labeled as A, B, D, and R groups. The company’s products are sold mainly in the US, Europe (notably the Netherlands and Germany), Asia, and other global markets, with a strong focus on the sports shoe segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases predominantly in Vietnam, Myanmar, Indonesia, and to a lesser extent in Taiwan and other Southeast Asian countries. Sales are concentrated in the Americas and Europe, accounting for about 70% of revenue, with significant markets in the US, Netherlands, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lai Yih Footwear functions as a midstream manufacturer in the footwear supply chain, focusing on OEM production for international brands. It integrates upstream material sourcing and downstream product development collaboration with brand clients, while expanding into upstream integration through investments in local material suppliers and production facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include global multi-core production layout, talent investment through specialized footwear technical academies, and digital transformation via Industry 4.0 technologies. R&D focuses on sustainable materials, automated manufacturing processes, digital quality control, and product innovation to meet evolving market and environmental standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through OEM manufacturing contracts with international footwear brands. The company earns income from product sales based on production volume and complexity, with additional value from R&D services and supply chain integration supporting client product development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lai Yih competes with other major Asian footwear OEM manufacturers in Vietnam, Indonesia, and Southeast Asia. It positions itself as a leading global footwear OEM with strong R&D capabilities, diversified production bases, and a focus on high-quality, sustainable, and automated manufacturing to differentiate from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lai Yih reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$37.69 billion, a 35% increase from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$3.82 billion and EPS of NT$16.13. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased orders, expanded production capacity, and improved product mix, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and automation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lai Yih emphasizes its core competitive advantages in advanced manufacturing technology, stable high-quality production, and close collaboration with international brand clients. Its multi-country production layout reduces risk and enhances flexibility, while its commitment to sustainable and automated production processes aligns with global environmental trends and customer demands.
